# Logic changelog

Every change to how the dashboards count, calculate or classify — and every KP rule
behind it — newest first.

**Do not edit this file by hand.** `.github/workflows/changelog.yml` adds an entry for
every push to `master` that touches `scripts/*.py`, a `scripts/*_template*.html` page or
`scripts/projects/*.json`. The entry is the commit message, so write the rule there:
what changed, why, and whose rule it is (e.g. "KP 26-Aug"). Auto-refresh commits by
`visilean-bot` only publish data and are not listed.

Entries before 07-Oct-2026 were backfilled from git history: the commit that first
introduced each rule still in the code.

### 07-Oct-2026 11:19 IST · @Shreyanshi21 · `6cc68654`
**WBS shown follows the live VisiLean tree (KP 07-Oct)**

The Level 1-7 custom fields are written once at the MSP import and never follow a later
rename or move in VisiLean (task 45552 reads "33kV HT Cable Sizing" in the Gantt, but
its children still carried the old Level 4 name). The WBS path shown is now the
ancestors' live names; classification still reads the Levels.

Files: `scripts/ntpc_dash_data_v2.py`

### 06-Oct-2026 13:13 IST · @Shreyanshi21 · `9fea2e65`
**Other projects: Not Applicable counted, undated activities left out**

`dash_data.py` (every project except NTPC): an activity with trade "Not Applicable" is
counted in All Tasks and Delayed, as VisiLean does, but carries no weightage and no cost.
An undated leaf activity (no full baseline or planned window) is left out of All Tasks,
Completed and Delayed, as VisiLean does — checked S6a 2,300 − 33 = 2,267 and
S7 2,770 − 37 = 2,733.

Files: `scripts/dash_data.py`

### 06-Oct-2026 12:35 IST · @Shreyanshi21 · `0c89b5ce`

The VisiLean Delayed rule (see 06-Oct 11:46) was applied in `dash_data.py`, checked

Files: `scripts/dash_data.py`

### 06-Oct-2026 11:46 IST · @Shreyanshi21 · `e2626a58`
**Delayed = VisiLean's "Delayed Tasks" rule; copied tasks kept as their own rows**

`vl_delayed()`: Complete is never delayed. A task is delayed once its planned finish is
before the cutoff. A task not yet started is also delayed once its planned start is
before the cutoff. "Started" means VisiLean status Started / Warning / Stopped, or an
actual start date — not % complete. NTPC cutoff = yesterday (IST), checked against
VisiLean's export 06-Oct: 571 = 571. Replaces "pct < 100 and planned finish < today, or
planned start < today at 0%".

A task copied inside VisiLean keeps the original's MSP id (45878 and 52506 both carry
12789). The copy overwrote the original, so VisiLean counted tasks the dashboard never
saw. The lowest task id now keeps the MSP id, and each copy gets its own row with
weightage counted once.

Files: `scripts/ntpc_dash_data_v2.py`, `scripts/dash_data.py`

### 05-Oct-2026 12:30 IST · @VisiLean · `31eee657`

Drawing revisions carry an approval category (CAT 1/2/3) from the "Approval Type"

Files: `scripts/ntpc_dash_data_v2.py`

### 31-Aug-2026 20:42 IST · @Vikas-visilean · `496a2d65`
**Superseded revision carries no weight (KP 31-Aug)**

Under a deliverable whose children are all post-baseline revisions, the deliverable's
approved Weightage sits on the latest revision (by planned finish, then creation order)
and the earlier ones carry none.

Files: `scripts/ntpc_dash_data_v2.py`

### 26-Aug-2026 19:48 IST · @Vikas-visilean · `3c333108`
**Progress weight = VisiLean "Weightage" field (KP 26-Aug)**

Progress is weighted by VisiLean's own Weightage custom field (the approved Rev-2 model,
which sums to ~100 across the project), not by Cost. Cost is kept for the budget card only.

Files: `scripts/ntpc_dash_data_v2.py`

### 26-Aug-2026 11:30 IST · @Vikas-visilean · `02de1fae`
**NTPC: trade "Not Applicable" excluded (KP rule 26-Aug)**

An activity whose trade is "Not Applicable" (or "N/A", "NA") is out of scope: it is
dropped from every count, progress figure, weightage and table. Still in force for NTPC.
On 07-Oct-2026 this was 7 tasks (44985-44991), so the dashboard read 6210 tasks / 608
delayed against VisiLean's 6217 / 613.

Files: `scripts/ntpc_dash_data_v2.py`

### 25-Aug-2026 17:01 IST · @Vikas-visilean · `25813c28`
**Long-lead delivery dates from VisiLean's Supply summary row (KP rule 25-Aug)**

The Long Lead table's baseline and forecast delivery equal the dates VisiLean shows on
the package summary row under Procurement > Supply.

Files: `scripts/ntpc_dash_data_v2.py`

### 18-Aug-2026 16:13 IST · @Vikas-visilean · `7f62d885`
**Package and Department from VisiLean custom fields verbatim (KP rule 18-Aug)**

Package and Department are VisiLean's custom fields as typed. A Level-derived fallback
is used only where the field is empty.

Files: `scripts/ntpc_dash_data_v2.py`

### 17-Aug-2026 15:34 IST · @Vikas-visilean · `07026710`
**Forecast = VisiLean planned dates verbatim (KP rule 17-Aug)**

No re-forecasting on the dashboard side: VisiLean's planned start/end are the forecast,
and baseline start/end are the baseline. This applies to milestones too.

Files: `scripts/ntpc_dash_data_v2.py`
